fields.statement: rhiza hook ls lists the hook commands and where each is set, and rhiza hook run runs one by hand with a sample to test it

fields.acceptance: hook-commands.txtar: hook ls shows both unset; after git config rhiza.notifyCommand it shows notify from git config; with a recorded daemon state carrying --notify-command it shows daemon flag; daemon status --json shows the recorded commands; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza hook ls lists the notify and event hooks, each with its command and source: daemon flag (read from a live daemon's state), git config, or unset

fields.acceptance: hook-commands.txtar: hook run notify with a fake command appending stdin and RHIZA_INBOX_KIND writes one line and exits 0; hook run event sets RHIZA_EVENT; a failing command exits non-zero with its output shown; an unset hook exits 2; the daemon state's handled items are unchanged
fields.statement: rhiza hook run <notify|event> [--command c] runs that hook's command once with a sample payload through the daemon's runner, showing its output and exit status, and records nothing
